commands.name: clear
commands.description: Clear the captured log buffer and the Unity Editor console.

schema.title: console clear
schema.description: Clear the captured log buffer and the Unity Editor console.

commands.name: get
commands.description: Get captured Unity console output (Editor or Player; supports tail, level filtering, and follow via a cursor)

parameters.name: tail
parameters.description: Maximum number of most-recent entries to return

parameters.name: level
parameters.description: Minimum severity to include: log | warn | error

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Cursor: only return entries newer than this seq. Use the 'cursor' from a previous response to follow.

parameters.name: since_session
parameters.description: Session the 'since' cursor came from: pass the 'session' from a previous response. A cursor from another session is refused and the tail returned with reset=true.
